text:
marta: Quick onboarding check for falcon-lite-7b-ql v1. Two quick items: weights location + tokenizer quirk causing early truncation, and a serving-config sanity pass (continuous batching / cache / scheduler / max tokens). Ping owners and infra please.
kevin: weights in s3? paste path + checksum? who uploaded?
marta: weights are at s3://redwood-models/ingest/falcon-lite-7b-ql/v1/checkpoint-0003 (uploaded by me). sha256: abcdef1234567890deadbeef. tokenizer files in same prefix: tokenizers/tokenizer.json + merges.txt.
jonah: what exactly is the tokenizer quirk?
marta: tokenizer.json sets "eos_token_id": 1 but our runtime + HF serialization expects 2 for "</s>" which leads to early-stopping on long prompts. Repro locally:
```python
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
t = Tokenizer.from_file("tokenizer.json")
print('eos_id:', t.token_to_id('</s>'))
```
kevin: hmm, we can either fix tokenizer.json before model push or override at serving time with tokenizer_overrides.eos_id = 2. Which do you prefer?
marta: for speed I'm going to add the runtime override for the canary, and open a PR to correct tokenizer.json upstream. Proposed serving change below.
sara: also double-check max tokens for context. This model expects 8k context; don't cap too low.
marta: proposed serving-config (draft):
```yaml
model: falcon-lite-7b-ql
version: v1
continuous_batching:
  enabled: true
  max_batch_size: 24
  max_batch_tokens: 4096
  max_latency_ms: 60
tokenizer_overrides:
  eos_id: 2
caching:
  prefix_cache:
    enabled: true
    ttl_seconds: 3600
  kv_cache:
    enabled: true
    size_gb: 12
    eviction_policy: lru
scheduler:
  queues:
    - name: interactive
      priority: 100
    - name: batch
      priority: 50
    - name: background
      priority: 10
  preemption: true
limits:
  max_total_tokens: 4096
  max_generation_tokens: 2048
```
lee: kv_cache size 12G might be tight on p4d nodes, we should watch memory. ops-bot will simulate.
ops-bot: [alert] Projected memory usage for pool gp-p4d-48 with kv_cache.size_gb=12 is 88% (threshold 85%).
marta: ack, will lower kv_cache to 10G and enable dynamic_eviction: true. Also bump prefix_cache.ttl to 7200 while canary runs.
jonah: please run config validation and post output: `rwdctl validate-config s3://redwood-models/ingest/falcon-lite-7b-ql/v1/serving-config.yaml`
marta: ran it, output: 
```
$ rwdctl validate-config s3://redwood-models/ingest/falcon-lite-7b-ql/v1/serving-config.yaml
WARN: tokenizer_overrides.eos_id (2) != tokenizer.eos_token_id (1) -> override will be applied at runtime.
PASS: continuous_batching parameters within SLO (max_latency_ms=60, expected p95=78ms)
WARN: kv_cache.size_gb (12) may cause node memory > threshold -> consider 10G
NOTE: max_total_tokens=4096 supports 8k context via windowing, ensure client cuts correctly
```
deploy-bot: Canary started on pool gp-p4d-48 (3 replicas) for falcon-lite-7b-ql v1 at 2026-06-15T12:34:00Z :rocket:
kevin: :thumbsup: can we add a small test prompt that used to trigger early stop so QA can watch?
marta: test prompt posted to the canary checks: long-doc + "</s>" inside text, expected to not truncate until generation limit. Example: 
"""
Please summarize the following long document (do NOT stop at mid-sentence): <very long document >
"""
sara: I'll watch metrics and truncation logs. Ping if p50 >100ms or truncation seen.
marta: thanks — I'll update s3 serving-config, open PR to fix tokenizer.json, and assign @kevin for review of the PR. Will report back with canary metrics in ~30m. :white_check_mark:
